name: ClassSeatingPlanner
tagline: Seating charts with rules, auto-arrange and a real phone layout – saved in one Dataverse column.
description: A classroom seating chart planner for Power Apps and Power Pages. Draw the room from a preset or custom layout, drag or tap students into seats, keep students apart or together, honour front/back/aisle needs, lock seats and auto-arrange by mixed or similar attainment. Live rule checks, KPIs, teacher's view, print and a phone experience with bottom sheets.
features: Pairs, rows, group tables, horseshoe or custom JSON room
Drag and drop plus tap-to-place on touch and keyboard
Separate / together / front / back / fixed-seat rules with live issue badges
Auto-arrange: mixed attainment, alphabetical, random, similar attainment
Lock seats, undo, clear, teacher's view, print
KPIs, roster filters, colour by attainment or desk group
Phone tabs with seat and student bottom sheets
Outputs: counts, violations, desk groups, selection, isValid; browser change event
